'''2012 Canadian Nationals Peter Tenneson LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Peter Tenneson]] at [[2012 Canadian Nationals]] (Nationals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]]
* '''Username:''' patmagroin
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Nationals
